verdict.rationale: The marketing claim to "identify important emails & todos with a single click" and "sweep away the rest" points to some one-stroke bulk dismissal, and a user reports clearing a backlogged inbox in 10 minutes. Neither describes manually selecting many conversations and then applying archive, label, or done to the selection. Missing for 10: explicit multi-select of arbitrary conversations, bulk labeling, bulk mark-done, documentation of the bulk-action UI or shortcuts, and hands-on corroboration of selection-based batch actions.
